control_flow: Forever: avoidWalls checks the right light; if it is below 60, it checks FRONT and LEFT and turns, otherwise it calls driveInTheDark.
driveInTheDark: if the left light is below 70, it drives forward, otherwise it calls stopAtWall.
stopAtWall: if FRONT sees an obstacle, it stops, otherwise it calls followLine.
followLine: if the line tracker sees black, it curves left, otherwise it curves right.

likely_intent.description: Drive through tunnels without hitting their walls.

branches.outcome: the right light is below 60: it checks the obstacle sensors
the right light is 60 or more: it calls driveInTheDark

uncertainties: You only said not to hit tunnel walls; you didn't say what the robot should do in bright light, so those situations have no expected behaviour.
In a left bend the program does not read the RIGHT sensor, so it may drive into the right wall.
The program checks FRONT before LEFT, so in a right bend it may turn left if FRONT sees the wall.
The program also follows a line and stops at walls in bright light, which you didn't mention.
